questions.text: Project prj-maternity-7 has no Applications registered yet (GET /api/projects/prj-maternity-7/apps returns an empty list), but a Work Item for REQ-marketing-process-node-management requires an applicationId. Which Application should this work item be created under - an existing one that needs to be added first, or a new Application (e.g. a marketing-process-management service/app)? Please specify the application name/id to use, since I have no way to create Applications myself.
